dialogues.speaker: Tobahaq
dialogues.text: You're surprisingly strong, kiddo. I'm impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Tobahaq
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for joining our competition. Not only did you defeat us, you even won against Ipacura.

dialogues.speaker: Tobahaq
dialogues.text: He's happy — he seems to realize we were going easy on him... And we're happy too. It's enough for us that he has a happy summer here.
